Tesseract OCR browser assets

Engine project requested by the owner:
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract

Unmodified distributions from npm (downloaded November 14, 2026):
- tesseract.js 6.0.1, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js, Apache-2.0.
- tesseract.js-core 6.1.2, https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core,
  Apache-2.0. Contains the WebAssembly builds of Tesseract/Leptonica.
- @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0, https://github.com/naptha/tessdata.
  English 4.0.0_best_int/eng.traineddata.gz, the integer LSTM model.
  The upstream tessdata repository distributes trained data under Apache-2.0;
  its license is retained in LICENSE-tessdata. The npm package metadata labels
  its packaging MIT. No package wrapper code from that package is distributed.

Upstream licenses and bundled JavaScript dependency notices are retained beside
these files. The four embedded-WASM .wasm.js variants are included so the worker
can choose a compatible SIMD or non-SIMD build. Language and engine downloads
use the application's own static origin. No OCR service or CDN is contacted.

The application adapter static/js/document-ocr-reader.js uses the pinned worker
protocol from tesseract.js/src/createWorker.js to own the native Worker from
startup and release it on cancellation, failed downloads or timeout. Re-run
the real browser OCR checks before upgrading these assets. App-specific code
does not modify the upstream bundles. See manifest.json for SHA-256 checksums.
